description: Announces a planned maintenance window on a status page. All fields are required: `title`, `description`, `started_at`, `ended_at` and the list of `servers` (`{ id }[]`). Monthly quota: `status_page_planned_maintenances_per_month_limit` — 403 on overflow.

confirm.description: Set to true to authorize this write/destructive call even if STATUSER_ALLOW_WRITE is not enabled in the server config. Required for one-off overrides.

servers.description: Status-page servers affected by the maintenance. Use `status_page_get` to find ids.

name: status_page_maintenance_schedule
title: Schedule planned maintenance
